description: This file defines the MicCaptureManager class, which manages microphone input, speech recognition, and conversation flow for an Android application. It includes permission handling, speech recognition setup, state management, and communication with a voice gateway, supporting a conversational voice interface.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: Enumeration representing the roles in a voice conversation, either User or Assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing an entry in the voice conversation, including id, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: Main class managing microphone input, speech recognition lifecycle, conversation state, and communication with a voice gateway, supporting voice recognition and response in an Android app.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the microphone input and manages starting/stopping speech recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses speech recognition to accommodate text-to-speech output, ensuring no microphone input is captured during TTS.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes microphone input after TTS has completed.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes events received from the voice gateway, updating conversation and recognition state based on event type.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts speech recognition session if permissions are granted and recognizer is available.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recognition session and releases related resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Begins a recognition session with configured intent parameters.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of the speech recognition after a delay.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Queues recognized speech text into the conversation and message queue.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Sets a delayed task to flush partial transcript into conversation if idle for a period.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Updates the observable message queue list.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next message in the queue if recognition is idle and gateway connected.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for the current recognition run, to handle no response from the gateway.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks the current recognition turn as complete, proceeds to next queued message.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns a status string indicating queued message count and waiting state.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Adds a new conversation entry and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing conversation entry by ID.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Inserts or updates the assistant's latest message in the conversation.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Speaks the assistant's reply asynchronously.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables the microphone and releases recognizer resources.

methods.name: hasMicPermission
methods.description: Checks if microphone permission is granted.

methods.name: parseAssistantText
methods.description: Extracts the assistant's message text from a JSON payload.
